diagnosis.root_cause_explanation: The handler registry maps the 'DELIVERY' event type to AuditHandler.class instead of DeliveryHandler.class. When dispatch() is called with eventType='DELIVERY', reflection instantiates and invokes AuditHandler.handle(), which only writes an audit log entry and silently drops the delivery. No exception is thrown because AuditHandler is a valid EventHandler implementation.
